attributes.name: right_arm_only
attributes.text: Only the right arm moves while the rest of the body stays still.
attributes.definition: The right shoulder, elbow, wrist and hand carry all of the motion; the left arm, head, torso and legs show little movement.

attributes.name: both_arms_symmetric
attributes.text: Both arms move together in mirror-image paths.
attributes.definition: The left and right arms perform the same motion at the same time, mirrored across the body midline.

attributes.name: asymmetric_two_hand_roles
attributes.text: Both hands are used, but one holds still while the other moves.
attributes.definition: Both hands are raised in front of the body; one hand stays mostly fixed while the other makes the main movements around or onto it.

attributes.name: wrist_driven_motion
attributes.text: The motion comes mainly from the wrist and hand with little arm movement.
attributes.definition: The hand and hand-tip joints move noticeably while the elbow and shoulder stay nearly fixed.

attributes.name: forearm_swing_upper_arm_still
attributes.text: The forearm swings at the elbow while the upper arm stays fixed.
attributes.definition: The elbow bends and unbends repeatedly, moving the forearm and hand, while the shoulder and upper arm keep their position.

attributes.name: straight_arm_from_shoulder
attributes.text: The arm stays straight and moves from the shoulder.
attributes.definition: The elbow stays mostly extended while the whole arm rotates at the shoulder to raise, sweep, or circle the hand.

attributes.name: head_carries_motion
attributes.text: The head is the main moving part.
attributes.definition: The largest movement is at the head joint relative to the neck and shoulders, with the arms mostly at the sides.

attributes.name: torso_carries_motion
attributes.text: The torso bends or turns as a main part of the action.
attributes.definition: The spine joints change angle substantially (bending forward, leaning, or twisting), not just following a moving arm.

attributes.name: legs_carry_motion
attributes.text: The legs make the main movement.
attributes.definition: The knees, ankles and feet show the largest motion, through stepping, bending, kicking, or jumping.

attributes.name: single_leg_active
attributes.text: One leg lifts and moves while the other leg supports the body.
attributes.definition: One leg leaves the floor and moves forward, sideways, or down while the other leg stays planted, not alternating.

attributes.name: arm_with_torso_rotation
attributes.text: An arm moves together with a twist of the torso.
attributes.definition: While the arm swings or reaches, the shoulders turn relative to the hips, so the torso rotation adds to the arm path.

attributes.name: hands_and_head_together
attributes.text: Both the hands and the head are engaged, with the head bent toward the hands.
attributes.definition: The hands are held together in front of the body and the head bends down toward them for most of the action.
